title: EstimateSlabReinforcement
description: EstimateSlabReinforcement: Slab reinforcement for a floor configuration where the reinforcement has been defined as an estimated density.

SlabReinforcement.description: Amount of reinforcement in the main slab. ReinforcementDensity: The reinforcement density of an element and its material.

PrestressTendonDensity.description: Amount of Prestress tendon in the slab. Will be null if the slab does not contain any prestress tendons. ReinforcementDensity: The reinforcement density of an element and its material.
